title: Infomaniak transitions to a foundation model to protect user data privacy
summary: Infomaniak, a European cloud provider, is transitioning to a foundation model to enhance user data privacy and ensure data sovereignty within European jurisdiction. This move positions them as a sovereign cloud alternative to US-based hyperscalers, offering businesses AI capabilities while maintaining strict data control.
problem_solved: Addresses data privacy concerns and loss of sovereignty when using cloud services from US-based hyperscalers.
why_valuable: Enables European enterprises to leverage AI capabilities while keeping data within European jurisdiction and under user control.
